createDescription: Add a new artifact repository to your registry.
keyTaken: Repository key "{key}" is already taken. Please choose a different key.
stagingHint: Staging repos hold artifacts for review before promotion to a release repository. Configure promotion rules after creation.
upstreamUrlHint: The upstream registry URL to proxy requests to.
credentialsHint: Credentials are stored encrypted and used when fetching artifacts from the upstream registry.
noEligibleMembers: No {format} local or remote repositories available. Create some first.
memberSelectHint: Select repositories to aggregate. Order determines priority.
publicDisabled: Public repositories are disabled by the operator.
quotaHint: Maximum storage for this repository. Leave empty for no limit.
editDescription: Update the repository name, description, or visibility.
editKeyWarning: Changing the key will update all URLs for this repository.
removeWarning: Removing credentials will cause upstream requests to fail if the registry requires authentication.
credentialsEditHint: Credentials are stored encrypted and saved separately from other repository settings.
deleteDescription: Deleting "{key}" will permanently remove all artifacts and metadata. This action cannot be undone.
